Elena / team,

Short answer: we can honor the 12% discount band tied to committed ARR, not the micro cadence of invoice runs. That means if GreenWave signs to the committed volume threshold ($200k/mo equivalent) we will keep the 12% unit discount even if you move to monthly invoicing. A few implementation notes:

- Billing metadata: we will accept the GW-Entity tag in the PO and use it as the invoice 'Bill-To' reference. Please confirm the exact string to appear in the header (GW-Entity: <value>).
- Invoice timing: switching to monthly means invoices will reflect the full month consumption; payment due Net45 from invoice date.
- Accounting treatment: because we recognize the discount relative to committed ARR, we will issue monthly invoices at the contracted discounted rate; however, we reserve the right to reconcile at quarter close if actual usage deviates below the committed floor (standard true-up).
- Preauth / credit: for monthly invoices on high-volume accounts we typically require a single preauthorization PO line or an initial prepay credit to cover month one in case of delayed AR. This is negotiable; if your AP timeline can't advance a prepay, we can accept a PO + Net45 but will need an executive credit approval.

Ben - please attach the variant quote (monthly invoice column) and mark the invoice-sprint field. Vanessa — flag any MSA clauses that would block Net45 or prepay carveouts.

Regards,
